```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
lastfm_data <- read_csv("/Users/elizapalmer/Documents/GitHub/ds212-portfolio-epalmer-dev/pvj/rawData/lastfm_data_updated.csv")
```
#Sorting through data to decide what to make a visualization of

```{r}
lastfm_data %>%
  count(Artist, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
music_2025_byMonth <- lastfm_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(Date, "2025")) %>%
  mutate(Date = dmy_hm(Date)) %>%
  mutate(month_name = month(Date, label = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(month_name) %>%
  summarize(total_scrobbles = n())
```

```{r}
music_2025_byMonth %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = month_name, y = total_scrobbles, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
music_2025_byArtist <- lastfm_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(Date, "2025")) %>%
  count(Artist, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
music_2025_byArtist %>%
  filter(n > 180) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = Artist)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
top_artist <- lastfm_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(Date, "2025")) %>%
  count(Artist, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Artist)
```

```{r}
artist_monthly <- lastfm_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(Date, "2025")) %>%
  filter(Artist %in% top_artist) %>%
  mutate(
    Date = dmy_hm(Date),
    month_name = month(Date, label = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  count(Artist, month_name, name = "scrobbles")
```

```{r}
artist_monthly %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = month_name, y = reorder(Artist, scrobbles, FUN = sum), group = Artist)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(size = scrobbles, color = scrobbles))
```

```{r}
ggplot(artist_monthly, aes(x = month_name, y = reorder(Artist, scrobbles, FUN = sum), fill = scrobbles)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Listening Heatmap by Artist",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "Number of Listens"
  )
```
